name: Toamasina
description: Madagascar's main port city, Toamasina — known as Tamatave in French — sits on the eastern coast facing the Indian Ocean. It is a city shaped by movement: of goods, of people, of history. The climate is tropical and humid; the light different from the highlands, filtered through casuarina and traveller's palms. The city's history as a trading port has made it a crossroads of cultures. The eastern coast was also the primary site of the 1947 uprising and its brutal suppression — geography that gives this region particular weight in Malagasy historical memory.
